newsitem.title: UK: NatWest up in firm sector, Govett positive.
newsitem.headline: NatWest up in firm sector, Govett positive.

text.p: Shares in National Westminster Bank Plc rose on Monday in a firm banking sector as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett repeated their positive stance on the stock following a research note last Tuesday, traders said.
NatWest shares were up 11p at 714 by 1421 GMT, near the record 719p set March 1.
Buoyed by diminished fears over higher interest rates, other bank stocks also rose, with Barclays Plc up 9-1/2p at 974 after setting a record 976-1/2 and Lloyds TSB Group Plc up 4p at 394-1/2.

Hoare Govett's note on NatWest last week said domestic cost-cutting by the bank, together with last month's debt securitisation, would bring the company's return on assets closer to that of rival Barclays.
